name: B10-0156/2024 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the UN Climate Change Conference 2024 in Baku, Azerbaijan (COP29)
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its position ahead of the COP29 climate summit in Baku. It calls for countries to agree a new climate finance goal, to commit to moving away from fossil fuels, to cut methane emissions, and to fund help for poor countries hit by climate disasters. It also criticises Azerbaijan's human rights record and the choice of a former oil company executive to lead the summit. This is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is Parliament's wish list for the COP29 talks.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments, who must now take these demands into the summit.
- **What happens next:** EU negotiators push these points at COP29 in Baku, 11–22 November 2024.
